answer: Stop sybils with carrier-attested identity: every agent binds its key to one real eSIM verified by a mobile carrier, so a vault of fakes cannot hide behind one phone. To join, an agent (1) registers its eSIM attestation, (2) the carrier confirms one SIM per identity, (3) re-attests monthly, and (4) any duplicate SIM bans both keys. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 eSIMs at $5 each plus $2 a month each, about $50,000 upfront and $20,000 monthly, while one honest agent pays $7. Like basalt pillars rising from a desert oasis, each real identity stands on solid ground no software can fake.
